newsitem.title: USA: Valassis to step up share repurchases.
newsitem.headline: Valassis to step up share repurchases.

text.p: Valassis Communications Inc said Thursday it was weighing a more aggressive share repurchase strategy in 1997 and noted that its biggest shareholder has agreed to participate in the company's buyback plan this year.
It said Conpress Caymen LDC will sell back to Valassis, on a monthly basis, an equivalent number of shares purchased by Valassis on the open market.
Conpress has a 50 percent stake in Valassis.

In May 1996, Valassis' board authorized the repurchase of up to five million shares, or about 11.5 percent of the shares outstanding. As of December 31, 1996, it had bought back about 1.3 million shares, without Conpress' participation.
The company currently has 42.1 million shares outstanding.
Valassis said a more aggressive repurchase strategy in 1997 might be warranted based on cash flow projections showing improvement over 1996.

"We believe our rationale for this strategy is sound, since we expect to generate enough cash to complete the authorized share repurchase during 1997 should we decide to allocate all funds to the buyback," said Robert Recchia, chief financial officer.

"We requested that Conpress become active in the matching of shares we repurchase to keep their ownership at existing levels, lessen the effect of the buyback on the public float and minimize speculation about any 'price threshold' Conpress may or may not have," Recchia added in a statement.
Valassis prints and markets consumer promotion products.
